anomaly_donation_bridge_voting_material.dds is a lossless radial UV repack of
the existing casino inset material in anomaly_donation_bridge_roulette_atlas.dds.
No new artwork or lighting was generated. The original atlas is unchanged.
Reproducible tool: scripts/pack-voting-material.py.
